publishedfiledetails.title: Project Zomboid Respawn Redux
publishedfiledetails.description:
Death doesn't have to be the end. Save your character with one click - on death, a new character with the same name is restored right where you saved: skills, stats, position, and (optionally) equipment.

[h2]How it works[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hit [b]Save Player[/b] whenever you like. Only that snapshot counts - die, and any new character with the same first and last name is restored from it.
[*] No need to remember the name: saving adds a "PZR <name>" entry to the character creation Saved Presets dropdown that fills in the name and appearance for you.
[*] Each character on an account gets its own save slot, so multiple survivors (and multiple players on a server) can all use the mod side by side.
[*] Respawning has a price: each skill has a chance to drop a level (fully configurable, see below).
[*] [b][CHANGED in v2.2][/b] Death destroys nothing any more: whatever the respawn doesn't hand back drops on the ground where you died instead of being deleted, and your corpse (or the zombie it becomes) is emptied the moment you die - in multiplayer too, handled server-side, so nothing sits lootable and nothing wanders off with your gear.
[*] [b][NEW in v2.2][/b] Died and logged out before respawning? The restore now picks up automatically the next time you log in - even across a server restart. Previously this left you with a blank character.
[/list]

[h2]Per-character options[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Keep Clothes[/b] [b][CHANGED in v2.2][/b] - the old Keep Equipped, renamed (your existing setting carries over). Respawn wearing what you saved in: your outfit and your bags, but the bags come back empty. Everything you were carrying drops on the ground where you died, so nothing is destroyed and you have a pack to haul it home in. The corpse and any zombie it becomes are emptied, so nothing is duplicated and nothing wanders off with your loot.
[*] [b]Keep Pack Contents[/b] [b][NEW in v2.2][/b] - your bags also come back holding what they held when you saved. Only what you added to a bag since then drops where you died. Requires Keep Clothes, and is off by default - existing characters must tick it and re-save. Note this is the looser setting: the restore is a snapshot, so gear stashed somewhere safe before dying comes back as a second copy. Server admins can lock it off.
[*] [b]No Skill Penalty[/b] - disable the skill loss roll.
[*] [b]Cure Infection[/b] - the restored character has the zombie infection removed. Get bitten, save, respawn clean.
[*] [b]Heal Injuries[/b] - respawn with wounds and pain fully healed.
[*] [b]Respawn At[/b] [b][NEW in v2.1][/b] - choose between your save point and the world's normal spawn (the server's spawn region, your start town, or a safehouse). Pick Default Spawn to keep your skills, stats and gear without keeping your location.
[/list]
Options are stored with your save - set them, then hit Save Player again to apply them. Keys always survive death, riding along on your own key ring.

[h2]Sandbox options (server admins)[/h2]
A "Respawn Redux" sandbox page lets you tune the skill loss chance (default 15%) and the minimum skill levels for passive and regular skills.

New in v2.1: every per-character option has a [b]pair[/b] of settings - its value, and whether players may change it.
[list]
[*] [b]Players can change: on[/b] - your value is just the starting point for new characters. Players set it themselves from there.
[*] [b]Players can change: off[/b] - the control is greyed out and pinned to your value. This works [b]in both directions[/b]: lock Heal Injuries on so every respawn is fully healed, or lock Keep Clothes off so nobody keeps their gear through death.
[/list]
Locks are enforced on the server, not merely hidden in the interface, so an out-of-date or modified client cannot tick past them - and they apply to characters who already saved with a different setting. Every option defaults to changeable, so existing worlds behave exactly as they did before.

[h2]UI[/h2]
[b][CHANGED in v2.21][/b] The mod docks as an icon at the bottom of the left sidebar, stacking below the game's own icons and those of other mods. Click it (or press SHIFT-U) to open and close the window, which appears beside the sidebar and never opens on its own. Hover the "?" for full in-game instructions. The log area reports every save, restore, and penalty roll, and keeps its messages while the window is closed.

Build 42, singleplayer and multiplayer.

All credit goes to the original author. This Redux is a continuation of his work.
